plain: In Brazil in 1957, a man named Antonio Villas Boas is said to have been taken aboard a craft and to have had sex with a being who looked like a woman. The researcher Mike Masters describes it, saying Villas Boas called her a woman who looked a little different from women he knew, with slightly higher cheekbones and a pointier chin. Michels mentions the case himself on an episode about Brazil, placing it in the 1960s and calling it one of many cases where people seem to interact with the beings and go up on the ships. It is told as a case of physical contact between humans and visitors.
